material.locator: UNSD Recommendations (2025, rev. 2), Executive Summary recommendations 1–3; Chapter 3 “Compiling statistics on stocks and flows of migration” and §3(a), pp. 17–22; Chapter 2 §2(a), pp. 7–10.
material.description: Directly supports the need to align migration definitions, residence criteria, reference periods, stocks and flows for comparable statistics; it does not prescribe a legal status or an individual migration procedure.
